implementation.file: Each Picture channel owns a typed File Parameter. Generic Inspector edits, ConfigurePictureFile, configurePicture/configurePictureFile scripts, typed Set Picture File commands and targeted ImportPicture all edit that owner without allocating or forwarding through an Asset. New ImportPicture creates one Picture subtree; copies own independent File Parameters.
implementation.reload: ReloadPicture, the compact channel header action, typed command and reloadPicture script method advance a channel-owned runtime generation and its existing capture guard. Guard subscriptions immediately wake the preview worker; no authored edit/history step, polling or extra node is needed. Capture preserves the generation in frozen playing owned media. Project load starts fresh runtime generations and never replays Reload.
implementation.resources: Preparation groups equal locators within one project/root and allocates a logical source identity independent of all owner UUIDs. One owner changing File cannot collide with a group retained by a peer. Same-path Reload replaces the shared affected group once, preserving unrelated healthy images. Unique decoded images count once for preparation/source and revision-guard admission. Worker scopes, memory limits, cancellation and retirement remain bounded.

implementation.fixtures: Retired separate native asset/channel forwarding fixtures are replaced by one generic File workflow reusable by native and bundled headless hosts. Source/reload/fit callers use owned File values. Public source API and owning docs are updated, with concurrent documentation edits preserved.
